faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about ITAD, data erasure, and compliance.

items.question: What is ITAD?
items.answer: ITAD (IT Asset Disposition) refers to all end-of-life management processes for IT assets: collection, diagnostics, data erasure, refurbishment, recycling, and certified destruction.

items.question: How does GreenTechCycle ensure data security?
items.answer: We apply the NIST 800-88 standard for certified data erasure, with full traceability and certificates of destruction for every processed asset.

items.question: Which compliance frameworks do you cover?
items.answer: Our platform covers 16 frameworks: NIST 800-88, ISO 27001, GDPR, CSRD, DORA, NIS2, ISO 14001, SOC 2, R2, e-Stewards, WEEE, Basel Convention, and more.

items.question: What is the processing time for an ITAD engagement?
items.answer: On average, our engagements are processed in 4 business days, compared to 3 weeks for traditional processes.

items.question: Do you offer carbon tracking?
items.answer: Yes, our Carbon & ESG module tracks the carbon footprint of each asset and generates CSRD-ready reports for your ESG reporting.

items.question: How does the WakiBox work?
items.answer: The WakiBox is a smart hardware device deployed on-site for secure intake, automated diagnostics, and IT asset collection.
